name: select
useFor: Use to choose one value from a list of five or more (Any State for a phone number, Shared or Dedicated for an iMessage line). Give it a Label or an aria-label, a placeholder when nothing is chosen, and group long lists with SelectGroup and SelectLabel. Control it with value and onValueChange (values are non-empty strings), and give the root a name so a form submits the value with FormData.
constraints: A field edge instead of the Shadow/S ring
Checkmarks at the left of the items
Animating items as they are highlighted
source: Figma 427:2715: Any State and Shared in Create Agent Identity (Modal States); the list is extrapolated as the console's menu
